<!--
If this pull request changes something a user can notice, add a changelog entry:

    pnpm changelog:new <slug>

It writes a file in `.changelog/` that the release note is built from; see `.changelog/README.md`.
Add as many as the pull request has user-visible changes. Skip it for internal changes (tests,
tooling, dependencies, refactoring), and for a fix whose issue title already says what changed.

To close an issue, put "Closes #<number>" below: the changelog entry only links it.
-->

- [ ] Each user-visible change has a changelog entry, or this pull request is internal only.
